_meta.source: original SWF, frame 0 of each level background DefineSprite
_meta.coords: Flash stage pixels; matrix=[a,b,c,d,tx,ty] as Flash Matrix (x'=a*x+c*y+tx, y'=b*x+d*y+ty); children are in display-list (depth) order = getChildAt order
_meta.fields: direct children are only listed when they are MovieClip (DefineSprite) instances, as pathParser casts getChildAt(i) as MovieClip; bounds=[x,y,w,h] untransformed local bounds of the character
